units.source_text: “主妇职务之中，最重要者乃忠实勤勉，为丈夫做贤内助。

en.t: Among the duties of a housewife, the most important are faithfulness and diligence, and being a capable helpmate to her husband.

units.source_text: 如此看来，其人不须过分风雅；

en.t: Seen in this light, such a woman need not be excessively refined or elegant.

units.source_text: 闲情逸趣之事，不解亦无妨碍。

en.t: It does no harm if she does not understand leisurely pleasures and cultivated amusements.

units.source_text: 但倘其人一味重视实利，蓬首垢面，不修边幅，

en.t: But if she cares only for practical gain, with disheveled hair, an unwashed face, and no attention to her appearance,

units.source_text: 是一个毫无风趣的家主婆，只知道柴米油盐等家常杂务，

en.t: if she is a dull household mistress with no charm at all, knowing only everyday chores such as firewood, rice, oil, and salt,
then what is one to make of that?

units.source_text: 男子朝出晚归，日间所见所闻，

en.t: A man goes out in the morning and returns at night, and what he has seen and heard during the day,

units.source_text: 或国家大事，或私人细节，或善事，或恶事，

en.t: whether affairs of state, private details, good things, or bad things,

units.source_text: 总想向人谈谈，然而岂可执途人而语之？

en.t: he always wants to talk over with someone; but can he seize a passerby and tell it all to him?

units.source_text: 他希望有一个亲爱的妻子，情投意合，心领神会，共相罄谈。

en.t: He hopes to have a beloved wife with whom his feelings are in harmony, who understands him without words, and with whom he can speak his heart out.

units.source_text: 有时他满怀可笑可泣之事，

en.t: At times his heart is full of things that make him want to laugh or cry,

units.source_text: 或者非关自己而动人公愤之事，颇想对妻子谈论。

en.t: or of matters that do not concern him personally yet stir public indignation, and he very much wants to discuss them with his wife.

units.source_text: 然而这妻子木头木脑，对她谈了又有什么用处。

en.t: Yet if this wife is dull and wooden, what use is there in talking to her?

units.source_text: 于是只得默默回思，自言自语，独笑独叹。

en.t: And so he can only silently think back on it, mutter to himself, laugh alone, and sigh alone.

units.source_text: 这时候妻子便对他瞠目而视，骇然问道：

en.t: At such a time his wife stares at him wide-eyed and asks in alarm:
What is the matter with you?

units.source_text: 这种夫妇真是天可怜见！

en.t: A couple like this is truly pitiful enough for heaven to pity.
